notes.title: Overhaul release date and new demo!
notes.content:
Hey folks! 

Big news!

Overhaul will finally be released on October, 14th! 

And to make this release date official, we've released a launch trailer! Enjoy! 

Also, and for the second time, we participate in the Steam Fest, with a fresh and bigger-than-ever game demo, so you have something to nibble on waiting for the main dish! 


We hope you'll enjoy the demo. Wishlisting Overhaul is still the best way to support the game before the release. 
We've opened a discussion post for you to leave your feedback after experiencing the demo, you can also contact us on our social media, @BreadPandaGames.

Thanks for sticking with us!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo!
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40609337/1fc49822906f8c347bec48625af684103da71f5d.png

From October 1st to 7th

You'll be able to venture into the Power Plant to get a first taste of the gameplay of Overhaul!

In this demo we've gathered over 40 rooms, 5 items as well as several mechanics and unlocks to give you a good idea of what's in store when you get the complete game!

We've created a discussion post where you can leave your feedback after experiencing the demo, you can also contact us on our social medias.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40609337/d3619a5b706542c133bd97806e1ad5b65be4008a.gif

Thanks for sticking with us! We hope you'll enjoy the demo!
